We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The case: Defendant Fu purchased a three-wheeled cargo motorcycle that was stolen. He knowingly bought stolen property? Let's read: He "委托庄某再物色便宜盗赃三轮摩托车" meaning he asked to find cheap stolen three-wheeled motorcycle. He bought it for 6000 RMB. He kept it for personal use. The victim discovered his stolen motorcycle parked at market, then saw Fu driving it away. Police seized the vehicle and took Fu.

Thus Fu is guilty of receiving stolen property, i.e., "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" (concealing/receiving stolen goods). The label used earlier for that charge is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". Also possibly "盗窃"? He didn't steal, he purchased. So the appropriate charge is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". The example earlier: For buying stolen bike, they charged that. So answer: [罪名]掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益<eoa>.

Check if any other charge like "非法买卖" but not in list. So single charge.
